statement:
open KdVPlan in ∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
 (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
  interp τ f t=Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) t) ∧
 ∀ L : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ f)
proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro τ hτ f hf hfs
  have heq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
      interp τ f t=Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) t:=by
    intro n t ht
    by_cases he : t=((n:ℝ)+1)*τ
    · subst t
      rw [← Nat.cast_one (R:=ℝ),← Nat.cast_add,(@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 τ hτ]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using ((@yui_aux_0045 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 τ f n hτ hf hfs).2).symm
    · have ht0 : 0≤t:=le_trans (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hτ.le) ht.1
      have hi : gridIndex τ t=n:=by
        apply (Nat.floor_eq_iff (div_nonneg ht0 hτ.le)).mpr
        exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hτ).mpr ht.1,(div_lt_iff₀ hτ).mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 he)⟩
      simp only [interp,hi]
  have hc : ∀ n m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (interp τ f):=by
    intro n m
    have hd:=(@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2 τ f hf n |>.2
    have hs:=(@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 τ f hfs n |>.2
    have hreg:=(@yui_aux_0071 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2 τ hτ n _ hd hs
    exact @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ _
      ((@yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 _ hreg m _ _) (heq n)
  refine ⟨heq,?_⟩
  intro L
  induction L with
  | zero =>
    intro m
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul]
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have he : t=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      subst t
      have hh:=(hc 0 m).1 0 (by simp; exact hτ.le)
      simpa using hh
    · intro t ht ε hε
      refine ⟨1,by norm_num,?_⟩
      intro r hr hdr
      have ht0 : t=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      have hr0 : r=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm hr.2 hr.1
      rw [ht0,hr0,sub_self,(@yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _).2]
      exact hε
  | succ L ih =>
    intro m
    have hh:=(hc L m)
    have h := (@yui_aux_0075 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 (m:ℝ) 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (((L:ℝ)+1)*τ)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg L) hτ.le) (by nlinarith) _ (ih m) hh
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using h)
